body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Venice, Italy. It starts at 11 Via Giovanni Pascoli.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> At M9 you can delve into the history of the 20th century. World Wars that forever changed the face of Europe, evolutions in everyday life, and enormous environmental and cultural upheaval. A lot happened in 100 years.
>
> On the first floor of M9, take a look at everyday life. How have the faces and bodies of Italians changed, what are the differences in social and gender roles between then and now? How do domestic spaces, clothing, and food differ? Then there's the almost unbelievable advances in technology to discuss.
>
> On the second floor, see the evolution of public and collective spaces. Learn how urbanization changed the country, and how national identity was formed through schooling and literacy.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €13.10. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 6 ratings and 5 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.
